notes: One background definition per BIOME, not per place. A battle in any place uses its place row's battleBiome — that is why 30+ places do not need 30 paintings.

Title backgrounds are NOT wired here. The 8 painted title-bg-*-v2.png files on main are a separate Title Backgrounds lane and are NOT used as menu or battle backgrounds until Mars has seen the actual PNGs (show-first rule). titleBackgroundsWired is false on purpose.
Colours are hex numbers (Pixi 0xRRGGBB as JSON integers). sky2 is the gradient second stop; farLayer is the parallax silhouette colour; platform is the battle platform colour.
Palettes are delivered via tint / ColorMatrixFilter at runtime (see pixiLayers.applyTimeTint), not as per-variant paintings. Day/night + season variants multiply these base colours.
titleBackgroundsNote: src/assets/title/title-bg-{snow,grass,water,sand,stone,forest,rain,night}-v2.png exist on main but are NOT referenced by any background, battle, or menu path in this PR. Show-first: Mars reviews the PNGs, then a later PR wires them if approved.
battleBackgroundNote: Battle backgrounds derive from the battled biome's row above (sky + ground + platform). No per-place battle painting exists or is planned. The sprite lane's battle-background v2 structure (sky/ground/platform/objects, 6 surfaces) is a separate painted-detail pass and is NOT replaced by this file.

layerNotes.groundMiddle: Tiled layer 'GroundMiddle': metatiles with layer=middle (tall grass, walls, signs).
layerNotes.actors: Player, NPCs, creatures — Y-sorted, Z by screen Y.
layerNotes.overheadTop: Tiled layer 'OverheadTop': metatiles with layer=top (bridges, canopies). Drawn over actors.
layerNotes.tintOverlay: Day/night + season tint + lightning flash. UI is NOT a layer: UI is React/DOM outside the canvas and is never tinted.
